title: Hedging on the Hill: Does Political Hedging Reduce Firm Risk?
authors: Dane M. Christensen; Hengda Jin; Suhas A. Sridharan; Laura A. Wellman
eligible_reason: Treatment is continuous (politicalhedge, balance of PAC contributions across parties) in firm and year FE regressions with time-varying controls. The Clean Power Plan event study is a single-policy design (treat = energy/utility firms x event days/year) interacted with continuous hedging (triple interaction). No binary staggered adoption.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe absorb(gvkey year) cluster(gvkey). firmcyclepanel.dta (firm x election cycle) and firmdaypanel.dta (firm-day, CPP event).
data_files_note: ReadMe: analysis panels shipped, winsorized at 1/99%.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract. Continuous treatment; not a DiD candidate.
